title: balance type chart data
description: The type matchup table embedded from testdata/golden/typechart.json (ADR-0013 P1-13.1, ADR-0015). services/balance/internal/master/type_chart_data.go is the executable version of the same contract; the embedded copy must be byte-identical to the shared golden file (TestEmbeddedTypeChartMatchesSharedData).

excludedTypes.description: Types the source tracks but balance does not (e.g. "???", "stellar"). Informational only; the loader does not read it.

types.description: Must be exactly the 18 balance types; order does not matter to the loader.

^(normal|fire|water|electric|grass|ice|f.description: A row must not be null and, when present, is never empty of meaning: an omitted attack/defense pair defaults to neutral (code 2); this row need not list every defense type.

code.description: Effectiveness x2 as an integer: 0=immune, 1=not very effective, 2=neutral, 4=super effective (ADR-0013 §P1-13.1).
